colors.layout: palette entry e: row e / perRow, x = (e % perRow) x 56; 56 colours, the 4 x 4 x 4 block's shell in the game's order (R_SetLightGridColors)

lightGrid.defaults: palette 0 below the grid, 1 elsewhere (with the sun)
lightGrid.note: the game's light grid (model lighting): ambient cube per grid point + sun visibility

sight.note: the world's sight-blocking brushes and terrain triangles (contents & 0x2001) for the light grid's sight traces (R_IsValidLightGridSample)

probes.encoding: colour / 2 (gamma space, x 2 in the viewer)
probes.faces: the game's face order (shots +X, -X, +Y, -Y, +Z, -Z of r_reflection_probe.cpp); a row per probe

note: Activision's geometry, extracted from the game files; see maps3d/NOTICE.md.
